Package com.devroic.jsonlite

Interface JsonLiteClient

All Known Implementing Classes:
JsonLiteClientImpl
public interface JsonLiteClient
The main interface for the JSON Lite client operations. This interface defines the CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) that can be performed on a JSON file.
